summary: System prompt. Accepts `cache_control` breakpoints when passed as blocks.
combines: System-prompt cache breakpoints can miss when the thinking configuration, effort, or `budget_tokens` change, depending on where the model renders the configuration into the prompt.
On Opus 5 with thinking disabled, system-prompt rules telling the model not to think increase XML tag leakage into visible output.
note: Authored by the orchestration pipeline; never a model-settings UI field.
